title: Considerations for Athletes who Peak Later in Sport Excellence Potential and Other Programmes
what_it_is: Considerations for Athletes who Peak Later in Sport Excellence Potential and Other Programmes

sections.label: HPSI athlete support criteria
sections.summary: Sport Singapore's HPSI designs athlete support based on current performance and assessed potential, not solely age, with no limit on support duration if criteria are met.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
sentences.text: Because our aim is to make sure every athlete fulfils their fullest sporting potential, Sport Singapore’s High Performance Sport Institute (HPSI) designs our support for athletes based on their current performance and assessed potential, rather than solely age.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
sentences.text: And we do not place a limit on how long athletes can be supported as long as they meet performance and potential criteria.

sections.label: spexPotential programme support
sections.summary: spexPotential provides targeted financial and programmatic support to athletes with potential for SEA Games gold, based on their sport's high performance pathway stage, for all ages.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
sentences.text: The spexPotential programme, in particular, provides targeted financial and programmatic support to athletes with the potential to achieve gold medal success at the Southeast Asian Games (SEA Games).

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
sentences.text: The spexPotential programme also supports athletes based on their developmental stage of their sport’s high performance pathway and it applies to athletes of all ages.

sections.label: spex framework late bloomers
sections.summary: The spex framework also supports late bloomers or athletes who switch sports.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
sentences.text: The spex framework also supports late bloomers or athletes who switch sports.

sections.label: Swimmer's spexCarding and spexScholarship
sections.summary: As a swimmer, she was supported by spexCarding from age 14 and awarded the spexScholarship at age 27.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
sentences.text: As a swimmer, she was supported by spexCarding from when she was 14 years old and was awarded the spexScholarship when she was 27 years old.

sections.label: Broader windows for spex grants
sections.summary: The Ministry is open to considering wider windows and different data points for spex grants to support athletes better throughout their careers.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Kenneth Goh (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: And so, in considering a broader window for these spex grants, I was wondering if that is something the Ministry will consider, to better hang on to our athletes and support them throughout their careers.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: I believe I know the athlete in question and actually, he was supported by our spexCarding programme, and the spexGLOW programme, which allowed him to train full-time for a specific period of time.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: I think to the Member's suggestion, for sure, because our focus is on helping every athlete achieve their fullest potential and therefore, we are definitely open to looking at the wider windows, different data points, but it is all with the view of how do we support our athletes better.
